crime_highlights: Ms. Hansen asked for repayment a number of times and, on one occasion, kicked Ms. Abigosis and fractured her arm
She said she would come back in a half-hour and if Ms. Abigosis did not have the money, she would give her a beating.
Ms. Hansen picked up an empty wine bottle and struck Ms. Abigosis on the head, breaking the bottle.
She struck her again a couple of times with the fractured bottle.
Ms. Abigosis suffered contusions and lacerations as a result of the forceful blows to her head and arms.
rationale_highlights: I have described some of the systemic and background factors which have played a part in bringing Ms. Hansen before this court.
there is no question that her unique circumstances bear directly on her moral culpability or responsibility for the offences before the court
Her personal circumstances are a product of the systemic and background factors which s. 718.2(e) was meant to address.

If I fail to take these into account, I would be violating the fundamental principle that a sentence must be proportionate to the gravity of the offence and the degree of responsibility of the offender.
I have already explained how these latter circumstances effectively reduce Ms. Hansen's moral culpability for the offence.
